a walkdown: Only if applicable questions remain after existing-record review, agree safe additional observations with the responsible specialist; no mandatory live test, sampling, shutdown, tuning, instrument or equipment change.
data_requests.how: A blanket-gas label is not vapor recovery, and a VRU record elsewhere cannot settle this tank's actual capture/coverage. S20 concerns crudeoil/condensate storage: known clean potable-water or inert-only service can be nonapplicable, but unknown or produced-water service must not be declared clean merely by name. Review existing qualified measurements/estimates and their limits before proposing new observations. EPA's simple GOR/throughput example does not provide composition/speciation, low-pressure total-volume metering or verified peak duty; actual pressure/temperature/composition/time and outlet matter. Suitable existing controls can be acknowledged. Any new sample, vent measurement or recovery change requires responsible safety/environmental review, not a generic instruction from this screen.

questions.decision_rule: Review actual product/vent/loss-source and existing control/recovery coverage, qualified quantity/composition/peak/time basis, compatible outlet and operating/environmental constraints with the responsible specialist. Blanketing or another VRU label is not proof of capture or global coverage. Suitable current control or nonapplicability can be acknowledged; unresolved service/source/duty remains explicit without mandated sampling, recovery equipment or site payback.

typical_benefit.wording: S20 reports high hydrocarbon-vapor capture and partner economics for particular crude-oil/condensate storage-tank VRU applications. These historical examples depend on vapor source, quantity/composition, operating conditions and a suitable outlet; no universal recovery fraction, payback or site benefit is assigned.
source_titles: S20: EPA Natural Gas STAR Lessons Learned, Installing Vapor Recovery Units on Storage Tanks

questions.limits: Source review: complete S20 EPA NaturalGasSTAR LessonsLearned Oct2006 pp1-9. Original95%/two-month headline remains historical; partner reports/examples are not this tank's verified capture or economics. Flash/working/standing and maximum versus total emissions differ; low tank pressures, control/vacuum prevention and outlet constraints matter. Additional measurement/sampling/design or emission-control decisions need applicable safety/environmental review. No current legal compliance or installed emissions are determined.
